global.title: Tesla reopens $50,000 Roadster reservations ahead of October 1 unveil
global.summary: Tesla has reopened reservations for its next-generation Roadster, asking buyers for a $50,000 deposit about two weeks before the car is even unveiled. The reserve page went live this week ahead of an October 1 reveal near Waco, Texas. It’s the second time Tesla has collected $50,000 for the Roadster

global.title: Cadillac’s go-fast electric SUV arrives makes its way Down Under
global.summary: Following the debut of its Formula 1 team earlier this year, GM’s global ambitions for flagship luxury brand Cadillac continue to unfold in the 2027 model year as the ultra-hot V-series Lyriq-V EV makes its way to dealers Down Under. more…

global.title: As diesel hits $10/gal., rumors swirl that stations are running out
global.summary: Last week, a number of diesel stations in California appeared on social media with the prices pinned at 9.99 – the highest number the pumps could display. Today, the pictures are showing something different: gas stations that are out of diesel entirely. more…

global.title: From 10-97% SOC in 9 minutes: Sunwoda joins the flash charging race
global.summary: Chinese battery brand Sunwoda has just revealed a new EV battery charging system that can add 100 km (~62 miles) of range to an EV every minute, and can take a battery from from 10-97% SOC in less than 10 minutes. At room temperature. more…

global.title: SONDORS’ abandoned 3-wheeled electric car just showed up for sale on eBay
global.summary: If you’ve ever wanted to own a genuine piece of electric vehicle vaporware history, now might be your chance. One of the most interesting artifacts from SONDORS’ more ambitious days has just surfaced for sale on eBay: the company’s three-wheeled electric car prototype. more…

global.title: Climate XChange is giving away more EVs than ever before in its 11th Annual EV Raffle
global.summary: What would you choose with up to $120,000 to spend on a fully customized EV – a Lucid Air, Rivian R1S, Porsche Macan Electric, BMW i7, or perhaps two EVs instead of one? more…

global.title: E-quipment highlight: 4,400 hp Wabtec FLXDrive electric locomotive [update]
global.summary: After nearly a year of operation on a dedicated track line at the Jimblebar iron ore mine in Australia, BHP is proving that these 4,400 hp battery-electric powered heavy-haul locomotives are ready for prime time. UPDATE 19SEP2026: there’s a video! more…

global.title: Swaptopus inches towards reality as CATL reveals new semi truck battery
global.summary: In a move that challenges Orange Juicer and Buick Electra for the highly coveted Best Name in the EV Business title, a new venture between CATL and Octopus Energy called “Swaptopus” has been formed to build out a European battery swap network for commercial trucks. more…

global.title: It’s finally here: Porsche puts wireless EV charging into production [video]
